__note: Keyed map for GET /api/v4/hierarchy/fetch/{BusinessEntity} (Create WO source module 54). The mock looks up the trailing BusinessEntity path param and returns { Hierarchy: { Title } }. Built node 'EHS: Get Hierarchy' -> Create task reads $json.Hierarchy.Title. Title is the EHS site name fed to EHSLimbleLocationMapping; the resulting Limble location name (shown in __maps_to) is what the Limble sandbox must contain (see test plan, Limble fixtures). Hierarchy is fetched for every form that enters the per-form loop, BEFORE the acceptable-answer and region gates, so BE-40 (drops at Answer gate) still needs an entry. BE-50 is NOT included: EHS-INSP-H is dropped at the QuestionsSelector filter before the loop, so its hierarchy is never fetched.
